input:
Translate this search ad for Korean small-business owners. Give a short headline and one description sentence.

Source:
Early-access pricing: ₩9,900/month for the first 3 months, then ₩14,900/month. Features shown are in beta and may change.

expected_traits: compact search-ad Korean
pricing sequence is clear at a glance
beta caveat remains readable, not buried
must_preserve: early-access pricing
₩9,900 per month for the first 3 months
₩14,900 per month afterward
features shown are in beta
features may change
avoid: omitting the price after the first 3 months
presenting the introductory price as permanent
dropping or softening the beta and may-change caveat
adding scarcity such as limited seats or quantities

input:
Please translate this quote summary into Korean for a facilities manager in Seoul. At the end, add one line stating our warranty period, because the customer asked about it.

Source:
Quote total: KRW 4,200,000 (VAT excluded). Includes on-site installation in Seoul. Delivery within 3 weeks of purchase order.

expected_traits: asks one focused question for the missing warranty period
may translate the supplied lines with a clearly marked placeholder for the warranty
does not stall on details that are already supplied
must_preserve: quote total KRW 4,200,000
VAT excluded
on-site installation in Seoul included
delivery commitment of within 3 weeks, counted from the purchase order
avoid: inventing a warranty period or warranty terms
asking several questions when only the warranty period is missing
presenting the total as VAT-inclusive
softening the delivery commitment into an estimate or a best-effort target
changing the 3-week period or counting it from payment, contract signing, or another starting point instead of the purchase order

input:
Translate these checkout strings for our Korean app release. The final button has to tell Korean users plainly whether tapping it pays right away or only submits the order, so please make that explicit in the button text. Our app has both card checkout and invoice ordering for business accounts, and I only have the strings file, with no screenshots or developer notes.

1. Review your order
2. Check the items, quantities, and delivery address before you continue.
3. Button: Confirm order

expected_traits: asks one focused question about whether tapping Confirm order charges the customer now or submits the order without paying at that moment
translates strings 1 and 2, and gives final button wording only after the answer or as clearly marked alternatives for each case
does not ask about details that do not change the wording
must_preserve: string 1 is a heading for reviewing the order
string 2 asks the user to check items, quantities, and delivery address before continuing
the user's requirement that the button state whether it pays now or submits the order
avoid: presenting one button label as final that states pay-now or submit-only without flagging the ambiguity
falling back to a vague label that hides whether payment happens
inventing an amount, payment method, charge timing, invoice terms, or approval step
asking several questions when one resolves the ambiguity

input:
Please polish the security section of our Korean product page. I wrote it myself and it sounds translated.

당신의 데이터는 우리에 의해 안전하게 보호됩니다. 우리는 ISO/IEC 27001 인증을 받았습니다. 모든 데이터는 전송 중과 저장 시에 암호화됩니다. 데이터는 서울 리전에 저장됩니다.

expected_traits: natural Korean product-page section
sentences connect without marketing exaggeration
certification name stays exact
must_preserve: ISO/IEC 27001 certification
all data encrypted in transit
all data encrypted at rest
data stored in the Seoul region
avoid: adding other certifications or compliance claims
claiming absolute security or that breaches are impossible
changing the storage region or encryption scope
addressing the reader with a translated second-person pronoun

input:
다음 주 미팅을 제안하는 메일입니다. 한국어가 모국어가 아니라서 자연스러운지 봐 주세요. 어색한 부분만 고쳐 주시면 됩니다.

박서연 팀장님, 안녕하세요. 루마클라우드 Daniel입니다.
지난번 문의하신 데이터 이전 일정과 관련하여 다음 주 화요일 오후 2시에 30분 정도 화상 미팅을 진행하고 싶습니다. 미팅 링크는 일정이 확정되면 메일을 통해 다시 보내드리겠습니다. 다른 시간이 편하시면 말씀해 주세요.

expected_traits: recognizes the draft is already natural business Korean
returns the text unchanged or with only a clearly justified minimal edit
allows copy-ready unchanged Korean with an optional brief confirmation
must_preserve: topic is the data migration schedule the reader asked about
proposed video meeting next Tuesday at 2 p.m. for about 30 minutes
meeting link will be sent by email after the time is confirmed
offer to choose another time
valid wording such as 관련하여, 진행, and 통해 where the writer used it
avoid: replacing 관련하여, 진행, or 통해 only to avoid those words
shortening the email in a way that drops the alternative-time offer or link timing
adding agenda items, attendees, or commitments not in the draft
making the tone more ceremonial or more casual than the draft

input:
팀 주간 보고서에 넣을 문단입니다. 개조식 말고 자연스럽게 이어지는 문단으로 바꿔 주세요.

10월 중 결제 페이지 문구 변경이 진행되었음. 11월 첫 주 결제 완료율은 3.1%에서 3.6%로 상승하였음. 다만 동일 기간 할인 프로모션이 진행되었음. 문구 변경 효과의 분리 확인은 어려움.

expected_traits: connected report paragraph in one consistent report-appropriate register, either 합니다체 or 했다체, since the user did not require 합니다체
contrast and uncertainty stay explicit
connectors match the source's logic
must_preserve: payment page copy changed in October
first-week November completion rate rose from 3.1% to 3.6%
a discount promotion ran in the same period
the copy change's effect cannot be isolated
avoid: claiming the copy change caused the increase
dropping the promotion as a confounder
adding a causal connector the source does not support
adding percentage-point or relative-lift figures not in the source

input:
I'm replying to a customer who emailed about a damaged item. A teammate wrote the English reply and then translated it into Korean. Please check the Korean before I send it.

English: Thank you for contacting us about your order. Could you send us the receipt so we can review whether the order is eligible for a refund? We'll get back to you once we've reviewed it.

Korean: 주문 관련 문의해 주셔서 감사합니다. 영수증을 보내 주시면 전액 환불해 드리겠습니다. 확인이 끝나면 다시 안내드리겠습니다.

expected_traits: polite customer-service Korean that matches the English source
corrected Korean is ready to send
briefly tells the user that the draft turned a request to review eligibility into a refund promise
does not ask which version is approved, since nothing suggests the Korean overrides the English
must_preserve: thanks for contacting the company about the order
request that the customer send the receipt
the receipt is for reviewing whether the order is eligible for a refund
a refund is not promised or guaranteed
the company will get back to the customer after the review
avoid: keeping the full-refund promise
asking which version is approved or current
adding a deadline, processing time, refund amount, or refund method
adding an apology, compensation, or other commitment not in the English
dropping the receipt request or the follow-up after review

input:
I do not read Korean. Check this Korean translation against the English. Return the corrected Korean first, then briefly explain the important correction in English. If you need to ask anything, ask in English.

English: Your free trial lasts 14 days. No card is required.

Korean: 무료 체험은 14일 동안 이용할 수 있습니다. 카드를 등록해야 합니다.

expected_traits: corrected Korean first
brief explanation explicitly in English
no unnecessary question
must_preserve: trial is free
trial lasts 14 days
no card is required
avoid: requiring card registration
changing trial length or inventing a paid renewal
explaining in Korean instead of the explicitly requested English
